title: Trellis.cpp Reaches Reference Quality for Open Image-to-3D
hook: A GGML-style CPU/non-CUDA port of TRELLIS.2 now produces 3D assets on par with the original reference implementation — no NVIDIA GPU required.
key_points: Trellis.cpp is a GGML/llama.cpp-style port of TRELLIS.2, an open image-to-3D model, part of a broader GGML asset-production pipeline.
After an extended debugging pass, output asset quality now matches the reference TRELLIS.2 implementation, per the author.
Runs without CUDA — works on non-NVIDIA GPUs, and even CPU-only for those willing to wait.
Puts a top-tier open-source image-to-3D pipeline within reach of anyone with a capable GPU (or patience), not just CUDA/NVIDIA users.
content_html: An open-source, GGML-style port of TRELLIS.2 — an image-to-3D generation model — has reportedly reached reference-quality output, according to its author on r/LocalLLaMA. Trellis.cpp is part of a broader GGML-ported "asset production pipeline" project bringing llama.cpp-style CPU/portable inference to non-LLM generative models.
extra_html: The author describes a lengthy debugging session (crediting help from a fellow contributor) that fixed enough bugs to bring generated 3D asset quality on par with the original reference implementation. Because it's built on the GGML approach rather than a CUDA-locked pipeline, it runs on non-NVIDIA GPUs and even CPU-only for those willing to wait — meaning a top-tier open-source image-to-3D pipeline is now usable well beyond the usual NVIDIA-GPU crowd. See the r/LocalLLaMA post (2026-07-17) for details and the project links.

related.title: A Hobbyist CUDA Kernel Brings DeepSeek-V4 Flash's Full 1M Context to One GPU
related.hook: Missing CUDA support for DeepSeek-V4 Flash's sparse-attention indexer meant llama.cpp needed ~256GB of VRAM for 1M-token context. One contributor's kernel patch shrinks that to a single RTX 5090.

related.title: SynCity 3000: Scene-Scale 3D Generation from One Prompt
related.hook: 3D generators are great at single objects but fall apart at scene scale. SynCity 3000 turns an image-to-3D generator into a convolution you can slide across an entire scene.
